title: A Living Skills Language for Student Futures

decisionLog.forum: Delivery lead proposition and mobilisation sense-check
decisionLog.outcome: Proceed to delivery design with the UK Standard Skills Classification treated as the leading candidate rather than a settled institutional choice. Year 1 will test taxonomy fitness, technical mediation and usable curriculum evidence before trailblazer adoption.
decisionLog.notes: Curriculum-facing discovery should start before the student-facing skills experience. The mobilisation route is discover, build capability with willing trailblazer partners, test portability, then institutionalise the shared architecture that proves useful.

decisionLog.outcome: Advance to resource planning with a bounded Year 1 technical proof-of-concept budget, a larger Year 2 trailblazer capability envelope and an evidence-led Year 3 institutionalisation envelope.
decisionLog.notes: The technical prototype tests the proposition and does not fund a separate production platform. Student-facing digital implementation remains a Digital Student Experience Hub dependency.
